A complete silver finger ring. The hoop of this finger ring measures c22mm in external diameter and c17mm in internal diameter. The hoop is rectangular in shape, measuring 2mm in width and 2mm in thickness. The bezel is thinner and wider than the hoop, having probably been created by hammering the hoop flat.
